methods.method:
prep: Day before: start the wild cherry syrup (see notes; make one batch for the whole plan)
prep: Heat oven to 350°F; line sheets with parchment
extract = macerate 24 h; strain; re-steep bark in warm water 1 h; strain; combine <- Wild Cherry Bark + Vegetable Glycerin + Water
juiced = add; top up with water to volume <- extract + Tart Cherry Juice
syrup = dissolve without heat (use 2 Tbsp per batch) <- juiced + Granulated Sugar @syrup
preserves = cook, crushing some fruit, to 220°F or until a drop wrinkles on a cold plate, ~25–30 min <- Sour Cherries + Granulated Sugar @preserves + Lemon Juice
jam = stir in; simmer back to a thick jam; cool completely <- preserves + syrup
filling = stir in off heat, to taste <- jam + Acid Phosphate Solution
creamed = cream until fluffy, 2 min <- Butter + Granulated Sugar @dough + Honey
wet = beat in <- creamed + Egg Yolks + Cherry Extract + Almond Extract
dry = whisk <- Flour + Freeze-Dried Cherry Powder + Baking Powder + Salt
dough = mix on low just until combined <- wet + dry
shaped = roll 1 in. balls (~19 g), press wells; chill on sheets while oven heats <- dough
baked = fill ~½ tsp each; bake 350°F 12–13 min until edges just set; cool on sheet 5 min <- shaped + filling
dust when cool <- baked + Powdered Sugar
methods.notes: PRESERVES: homemade from frozen pitted sour cherries or drained jarred Morellos; cook in a wide stainless pan (the fruit is acidic). WILD CHERRY SYRUP (Art of Drink, https://www.artofdrink.com/soda/cherry-phosphate) — full recipe makes 12 fl oz: 1 oz wild cherry bark, 1 fl oz glycerin, 4 fl oz water (first maceration), 4 fl oz warm water (second), 4 fl oz cherry juice, 10 oz sugar. One-third of the recipe covers 4 batches. ACID PHOSPHATE: the ⅔ tsp per batch keeps the drink's ratio (1 tsp per 1½ oz syrup) for traditional acid phosphate; with MacSweetie's, add drops to the cooled jam to taste and record the count. Built on your Jam Thumbprint proportions (yolk only, no added liquid, no baking soda) so the wells hold.
